notes.title: New patch - September 29th 2015
notes.content:
Adjusted the algorithm of formation movement on bridges.
 Added a pontoon bridge.
 Fixed improper removal of sprites in tables bug.
 Increased Iranian armed forces TOE in quick battle: Basij militia and IRGC units added.
 Added captured vehicles to Iranian units.
 Added Iranian Mohajer-1 drone and UAV launch mechanism.
 Fixed excessively shaded planes and helicopters bug.
 Expanded Iraqi army TOE.
 Vehicles without weapons, but with armed crew are not displayed as having no ammunition.
 Added indication of cancelling of moving by road.
 New achievement added.
 Adjusted effects associated with water.
 Fixed bug when game hangs after leaving the battle.
 Changed the algorithm of vehicle detour (bypass).
 Adjusted blood shader.
 Added RPD machine gun.

notes.content:

 Added automatic determination of moving by the road from direct control of tank or platoon in the column formation.

 New single missions: Airstrike and Defense.

notes.title: New patch - April 29th 2015
notes.content:
Added hotkey [\|] to activate the menu of crew commands.
 Different effects on detonation of ammunition and ignition of the fuel/charges.
 Ability to close the hatch on the current seat (button [P]).
 Added highlighting the center of the view, to set targets without cursor mode.
 Display for enabled smoke generator.
 Added an order for the commander and gunner to switch to active defense mode (hold [0]).
 Added an order for the commander and gunner to switch to active defense with respect to the priority targets (hold [9] ).
 Added a command [noparse][/noparse] to set/change the point on the route of active defense.
 Added a command [K] to turn the tank/formation directly on the priority target.
 Added the single missions menu.
 Hatches with attached preiscopes are automatically closed when crewmember get inside the tank.
 Fixed a bug with a closed wedge at the first loading of the projectile.
 Fixed bugs related to the dynamic time deceleration and decreased rate of fire for the machine guns in the simulator mode.
 Added a single mission explains the principle of a smoke shield order.
 Added a single mission explains the use of active defense mode.

notes.title: New patch - March 20th 2015
notes.content:
New more sharper textures for cockpits of M60 and T-62 tanks.
 Added the ability to control the movement of the tank with a manual gearbox [Q].
Animated gear levers [R], [F] and fixed gas [Mouse Wheel].
 Disappearing marks and labels on burned vehicles.
 Expand the number of soil types for which produces crushing surface of the landscape under the tank tracks.
 Added a setting to increase the details of the landscape.
 Added option to alter the distance of change LODs for objects.
 Added option allows smoothing of animation for nearest soldiers.
 The game end rules in a quick battle is changed. 
The endgame timer will only appear if there are no tanks that could take a player.
